# HYPE

HYPE is a Cork creative agency and digital marketing agency running social media, paid ads, brand films, PR and video production for hospitality, leisure, retail, food, drink and property brands across Ireland. Founded 2019.

## Contact
- Email: hello@hypedigital.ie
- Property content: property@hypedigital.ie
- Location: Cork, Ireland (service-area business, no public office)
- Every client message answered within 24 hours
